summary: Comprehensive testing of CRM system, Freelancer expense tracking module, Inventory sub-category styling, and Production Costing alignment. All 24 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed all features working as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created test leads, clients, and freelancers prefixed with 'TEST_' or 'Playwright' for testing - cleanup ran at end of pytest
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM and Freelancer modules fully functional. CRM has lead scoring (budget + urgency), 7 statuses, activity logging, at-risk flagging. Freelancer module is admin-only with payment tracking and dashboard aggregations. Motion Capture is available as a service type.

inventory_subcategory_orange.notes: Sub-category text (e.g., 'Microphones', 'Recording', 'Camera Accessories') displays in orange (#F9982E)

crm_dashboard.notes: Shows Leads This Month, Conversion Rate, Pipeline Value, Total Clients, By Status (7 statuses), By Source breakdowns

crm_lead_form.notes: All fields present: name, company, email, phone, source, service interested, budget, urgency, follow up date, assigned to, notes

crm_lead_scoring.notes: Score = 30 (budget > 500k) + 30 (high urgency) = 60. Verified in both backend tests and UI

crm_lead_status_update.notes: Successfully changed lead status from New to Contacted via Update dialog

crm_activity_log.notes: Activity log tracks all changes with timestamps and user info (e.g., 'Lead created', 'Status changed to Contacted')

crm_lead_to_client_conversion.notes: Converting lead sets status to 'Won' and adds 'Converted to client' activity log entry

crm_client_onboarding_checklist.notes: 5 steps: Welcome email, Contract signed, Advance received, Brief document received, Kick-off call scheduled. Toggle updates percentage.

crm_at_risk_flagging.notes: Backend API returns at_risk (>5 days inactive) and needs_attention (>48h) flags for leads

freelancers_admin_only.notes: Regular user sees 'Access Restricted - Only the admin can access the Freelancer Module'

freelancers_tabs.notes: Profiles, Payments, and Dashboard tabs all present

freelancers_motion_capture_service.notes: Motion Capture is available in service types list along with other services

freelancers_rate_types.notes: Rate types available: Per Day, Per Shot, Per Project

freelancers_payment_recording.notes: Can record payments with freelancer, project, description, amount charged, amount paid, status

freelancers_totals_update.notes: Freelancer total_paid and projects_count update after payment recording

freelancers_dashboard.notes: Shows Total Spent, Total Charged, Freelancers count, Payments count, Project-wise Spending

production_costing_alignment.notes: Travel Base Cost and MIS Costing fields visible in 3-column grid layout
